name: Multi-device PCI
full_name: Master-slave vascular interventional robot for complex coronary lesions (collaborative multi-instrument delivery, resistance-based haptics)
group: Yanshan University (Haoyang Yu, Hongbo Wang, Jianye Niu) with co-authors Chang, Liu, Wang (yu2023_design author list; same group as yanshan_yu2023)
force_sensing: Resistance measuring mechanism for delivery resistance
haptics_leader: Active drag system generates haptic force; force-velocity mapping avoids vibration
validation_detail: Series of bench experiments (abstract); full text Sec. 3.3: human vessel model, radial artery to aortic arch, 10 testers x 10 deliveries of a catheter and a guidewire with one guidewire exchange (W4_notes.md item 4)
